title: GLENN: Neural network-enhanced computation of Ginzburg-Landau energy minimizers
summary: In this work, we propose a neural network-enhanced finite element strategy to compute the minimizer of the Ginzburg-Landau energy based on an unsupervised deep Ritz-type strategy. We treat the parameter $κ$ as a variable input parameter to obtain possible minimizers for a large range of $κ$-values. This allows for two possible strategies: 1) The neural network may be extensively trained to work as a stand-alone solver. 2) Neural network results are used as starting values for a subsequent classical iterative minimization procedure.
